description: Never in the history of the 6th Plymouth District has a woman held this seat. I’m running to change that. Join us in fighting for more women in office at Women for JBR, a day of visibility and canvassing to elect Jessica Bradley Rushing as our next State Representative. Lt. Governor Kim Driscoll

title: I would be the FIRST WOMAN elected to this seat — ELECT JBR
